domain_labels.film: mixed real-film corpus developmental model (4 author-reported Portra400 and3 Ektar100)
domain_labels.digital: seven development digital Expert C targets control

question: Does the same learned geometry-preserving local restoration operator fitted to seven actual film-display targets produce worthwhile complete outputs on the four consumed digital challenges, compared with the same operator fitted to seven digital expert targets?
data_roles: All targets and challenges are development. Seven Inland film JPEGs versus seven previously consumed normalized FiveK aligned Expert C images. Index order is fixed broad scene coverage, not paired or same-scene matching. Italy19, prior checkpoints, authored style teachers, F, and all128 confirmation images are excluded.
decode: Film JPEG embedded ICC is converted to encoded sRGB8 using Pillow LittleCMS relative colorimetric intent without BPC; untagged files explicitly assume encoded sRGB. Normalized Expert C RGB16 is already encoded sRGB and is quantized by round(value/65535*255) to uint8. Both become float32/255 before identical full-frame bilinear-antialias resize to192 long edge and center zero padding/mask. Actual appearance targets receive no gain or aesthetic transform. Existing JPEG compression/native resolution/normalization blur differences remain confounds.
corruption: After preview creation, draw independent global common loggain U[-.35,.35] and three balance values U[-.1,.1], subtract their channel mean, and apply the exact stable SourcePreparation gain operator. Five percent of whole batches are chosen without replacement as identity corruption. Same sample indices, corruption coefficients, identity batches and initialization within each seed across domains. Corruption values are never model inputs; no crops or target normalization.
objective: Mean per-source masked RGB L1 to the uncorrupted target plus .001 squared adjacent coefficient differences plus .0001 squared coefficient magnitude. No additional expert identity loss, film teacher, response model or perceptual objective.
operator: Reuse exact SourcePreparation local=True,192 preview,16x16 unpadded coordinate grid, corrected stride8 feature-center mapping, a bounded1 common loggain and .25 zero-sum channel balance. Final head initializes exact identity. Inference uses the uncorrupted whole image. Meanfield ablation spatially averages each predicted constrained field; no extra model training. No optics or grain.
evaluation: All four final models only; no checkpoint selection. One independent frozen synthetic corruption schedule with8 draws per each of the same7 images, evaluated on both corpora. Save clean identity errors, reconstruction errors and raw arrays. These are same-image corruption diagnostics, not held-out generalization. Save four native challenge originals and all four model outputs plus four meanfields and coefficient arrays. Describe same-seed cross-domain versus same-domain cross-seed output MAE; n=2 is not a variance proof or causal stock attribution.
visual_rule: Root must inspect all four whole photos and fixed original crops. Severe face/text/content loss, bleaching, false transitions, destroyed night layers or incoherent lighting veto usefulness. Identity-like outputs and corpus-dependent changes without worthwhile rich comfortable complete appearance are negative. Compare both seeds with original, digital-trained and respective meanfield outputs. Numeric differences alone never promote. Visually promising results permit user comparison only, not a win claim. No arbitrary percentage promotion threshold or rescue sweep.
claim_ceiling: Exploratory target-corpus dependence and complete-output utility only. Confounded by scene, lighting, author, stock mixture, camera, rendering, resolution and JPEG history; no causal film-medium/stock attribution, calibrated simulation, generalization, user preference or product acceptance. Preserve all earlier negative pilots unchanged.
